node.title: KoalaBear v4 balanced-core allocation definition
node.statement: Under the frozen KoalaBear Grande Finale v4 first-match partition, prove exact bounds U_Q and U_new for the two sibling unpaid cells, or an equivalent certified three-way allocation, and define the balanced-core allowance U_K3_allocation by exact integer subtraction from B*=274980728111395087 after U_paid=981104. The joint reserve 274980728110413983 is not by itself a K3 allocation. The certificate binds row, partition digest, owner order, and all sibling atom proofs.
node.falsifier: Using the joint reserve as a K3-only budget without paying U_Q and U_new, a negative or mismatched allocation, or any drift in row, partition, owner, or integer unit.
